input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Developer, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including expert entity, book. The platform provides capabilities for common error handler, expert, book. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Developer, I want to create and manage expert entity records, so that I can track and organize expert entity data effectively.
As a Developer, I want to create and manage book records, so that I can track and organize book data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to browse job listings and receive personalized recommendations, so that I can find relevant career opportunities.
As a Developer, I want to use common error handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Developer, I want to use book capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
